paragraphs: Zeira [זעירא], sometimes Rabbi Zeira. Know that the Babylonian Talmud’s Rabbi Zeira [זירא] is called Zeira [זעירא] in the Jerusalem Talmud (see his entry). I am therefore uncertain whether Jerusalem Talmud’s Zeira is certainly Rabbi Zeira, or whether some are Rabbi Zeira and some the other Zeira named in the Babylonian Talmud. Beit Yosef, Orach Chayim 127: Rabbi Zeira, and another sage Zeira who was not ordained. Rabbi Zeira fasted 300 fasts; some say 900, and did not heed Megillat Taanit: Jerusalem Talmud, Taanit 2:13; Nedarim 8:2; Megillah 1:6. It appears this is Rabbi Zeira, whom we find fasting much in the Babylonian Talmud (see his entry). Rabbi Zeira was distressed, saying,“Would that I had father and mother to honor, and inherit Eden!” Hearing what Rabbi Tarfon and Rabbi Yishmael did, he said,“Blessed is the Merciful One that I have neither father nor mother; I could not do as Tarfon or Yishmael”: Jerusalem Talmud, Kiddushin 1:7. This Rabbi Zeira is not Rabbi Zeira [זירא], who had a father (see his entry). When he came up, he had blood drawn and wished to buy meat. He asked the butcher the price of a litra. The butcher said, “Fifty maah and one blow.” He wished to give 100 maah to avoid the blow; the butcher refused. He told him,“Do according to your custom.” Next day he entered the study house and said,“How bad your customs are!” They asked who had done it. He named the butcher; they sent for him and found his coffin going out: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Berakhot 2. This appears to be Rabbi Zeira, whose ascent to the Land is in the Babylonian Talmud; we do not find that of the other Babylonian Zeira. Zeira asked Rabbi Assi,“Did my teacher know bar Patya, in whose name you teach?” He answered,“Yochanan said in his name.” “Did you know Rav, in whose name you teach?” “Rav Adda bar Ahavah said it in his name”: end of Shekalim 2. But Shabbat 1:2 and end of Shemonah Sheratzim read,“Did you know bar Pedayah …?” Rabbi Zeira said to Rabbi Abba bar Zavda,“Did my teacher know Rav …?” See the rules. This Zeira appears to be Rabbi Zeira, Assi’s student; Assi was Yochanan’s student. Assi reports Pedayah; Zeira therefore asked whether he knew bar Pedayah, and Assi answered that Yochanan his teacher reported Pedayah. We do not find the other Zeira speaking with Assi. Likewise Rabbi Zeira asked his teacher Assi, Yochanan’s student, who had not known Rav, why he reported Rav. He answered that Rav Adda bar Ahavah, who knew Rav, reported him. He appears to have been a priest: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, She loshah Sheakhelu, mishnah 4, he arose and read as priest in the Levite’s place. Sedeh Yehoshua explains he himself read for the priest and then in the Levite’s place, since one priest is not called after another (see above, Zeira bar Ba and Yehudah Nesia). Rabbi Zeira is buried in Arbel (see Nittai of Arbel). He addressed Rabbi Abba bar Zavda as “my teacher” (see above). Rabbi Abba in his name. Rabbi Abba bar Zutra; Rabbi Abba bar Zemini in his name. In Rabbi Abba bar Mammal’s name. Rabbi Abba bar Kahana: Jerusalem Talmud. He said to Rabbi Abbahu. In Rabbi Avdimi of Haifa’s name. Taanit 3:12: Berekhiah, Zeira, Abba bar Kahana, in Yehudah’s name. He asked Rabbi Avimi bar Pappi. Rabbi Avin asked before him. Rabbi Idi bar Gershon. In Rabbi Adda bar Ahavah’s name, with Achva in brackets: Jerusalem Talmud, Ketubbot 4:5. Rav Adda bar Avimi was his student. He asked Rabbi Oshaya: Shekalim 3:2. He asked Rabbi Immi; Alexandri the Sadducee. In Rabbi Elazar ben Pedat’s name: end of Shekalim 4. Rabbi Elazar ben Antigonos. In Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Yannai’s name. In Ammi’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot. Abba Antoli. He called Assi “my teacher” (see above). In Rabbi Assi bar Chinena’s name; Rabbi Ashyan bar Nadvakh’s name. Rabbi Avun bar Chiyya asked him. Rabbi Bun asked before him: Kilayim 4:4; Ketubbot 2,“27, 4” [locator as printed]. Rabbi Bibi bar Avin and Rabbi Berekhiah (see above). In Giddel’s name. Rav Dimi bar Yosef said: Zeira said in Rabbi Chanina’s name. He asked Rav Daniel bar Katina. Rav Huna said in Zeira’s name: Berakhot 31a. Zeira said in Rav Huna’s name: Taanit 11b; Jerusalem Talmud, Kelal Gadol, halakhah 2, several matters. In Rabbi Hamnuna’s name. Rabbi Zerikan in his name. Rabbi Chaggai supported him as he walked, and asked him a question. Rav Chuna: Shekalim 4. Rabbi Chiyya was his teacher. Rabbi Chiyya bar Bun. In Rabbi Chiyya bar Ashi’s name. Rabbi Chiyya bar Acha of Jaffa. Rabbi Chiyya son of Rav Yitzchak Atishaya. Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 7, mishnah 3; he asked him in Ellu Kesharim. Rabbi Chanin in his name. He reported Rabbi Chanina. Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa before him. Rabbi Chanina of Anatot. He reported Rabbi Chananel. Rav Chisda said in Zeira’s name: Avodah Zarah 31a. In Rabbi Chisda’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Kelal Gadol 1; end of Taanit 3. In Rabbi Yehudah’s name. Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi in his name. Rabbi Yehoshua ben Gezori served before him. Rabbi Yochanan was his teacher: Bekhorot 30, end of side a. In Yochanan’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Ketubbot, Naarah Shenitpattatah and Af Al Pi. Yochanan in his name: beginning of Kilayim’s last chapter. Rabbi Yonah was his student (see his entry). In Rabbi Yonatan’s name: Kilayim 4; Af Al Pi 1. Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Bun in his name. Rabbi Yose supported him: Challah 3:6. He asked Rabbi Yisa: Jerusalem Talmud, Hakotev. Rabbi Yosa; Rabbi Yannai. Rabbi Yaakov bar Zavdi: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, folio 9. Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha in his name: Maaser Sheni 1:1. Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 7:3: Rabbi Yaakov bar Adda bar Atalya. He recited to Rabbi Yitzchak Atishayat. Rabbi Yirmeyah was his student; beginning of Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 1, in Yirmeyah’s name. In Keitzad Mevarkhin, mishnah 6, Yirmeyah wished to test Zeira. In Kahana’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Kelal Gadol 2. Kahana bar Tachlifa: end of Avodah Zarah 2. Rabbi Maysha said to him. Rabbi Menashe before him. In Rabbi Mattanah’s name. Bar Marina before him. He asked Rabbi Nachum, at Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Yishmael’s. He asked Rav Nachman bar Yaakov: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Naarah Shenitpattatah, halakhah 14. Rabbi Nicha bar Sava in his name. Nikomakhi recited before him. Rav Safra’s father asked him. Ulla: Jerusalem Talmud, Naarah Shenitpattatah. He said to Ulla the stonemason. Ulla bar Yishmael. In Mar Ukva’s name; Rabbi Pedayah’s name; bar Pedayah’s name. Rabbi Pilippi bar Periti objected to him. He asked Kalla. Rabbi Shmuel in his name: Jerusalem Talmud, Kelal Gadol 2; Ellu Kesharim; Shor Shenagach Dalet VaHe 1. Rabbi Shmuel bar Abba asked him. In Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman’s name. He hid from Rabbi Shmuel bar Yitzchak. In Resh Lakish’s name: Shekalim 4. Rabbi Shimon the judge before him. Rabbi Shimon bar Abba. Rabbi Shemayah bar Zeira, with or without ayin. In Rabbi Sheshet’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot 2:2.
